data.Name: Omegas Prospect
data.Description: Omegas exploration prospect, deepwater Barents Sea. Cretaceous turbidite play.

data.Name: Omegas - Exploration Assessment Workflow
data.Description: Seismic interpretation → AVO analysis → prospect risking → volumetrics → well design

data.Name: Omegas WPC - Prospect Assessment
data.Description: AVO-supported amplitude anomaly, 3-way dip closure against fault. COS: 25%.

Parameters.Title: AVOAnalysis
Parameters.Selection: Class III AVO response, DHI confidence: moderate

Parameters.Title: Volumetrics
Parameters.Selection: Unrisked P50: 45 MMboe; risked EMV: 12 MMboe

data.Name: Omegas WPC - Prospect Volumes (unrisked)
data.Description: Monte Carlo volumetrics: trap area × net pay × porosity × Sw × FVF × RF

data.Name: Source Rock Maturity
data.Description: Jurassic source rock maturity at prospect depth uncertain — limited well control in area.

data.Name: Top Seal Integrity
data.Description: Cretaceous shale seal — fault juxtaposition may create leak path at eastern closure.

MitigationActions: Seismic attribute extraction at seal level

data.Name: Reservoir Quality
data.Description: Turbidite channel-fill facies: porosity 15-25%, but net-to-gross highly uncertain (analogue range: 30-80%).

data.Name: Omegas - Prospect Evaluation Report
data.Description: Full prospect evaluation: seismic interpretation, trap geometry, risking, volumetrics, and drilling recommendation.

data.Name: Omegas WPC - Evidence Package
data.Description: Evidence for Work Program Committee drill/defer decision

Hierarchy.Name: Well Design
Hierarchy.Description: Preliminary well concept and cost estimate

data.Name: Omegas WPC - Drill Decision
data.Description: Work Program Committee: recommend drill or defer for the Omegas exploration prospect
data.DecisionSummary: Recommend drill. COS 25%, unrisked P50 52 MMboe, risked EMV 12 MMboe. Estimated well cost $85M. Positive EMV at >$60/bbl.

Alternatives.Name: Drill 2027 Q3
Alternatives.Rationale: Rig available, optimal weather window, seismic data mature

Alternatives.Name: Defer to 2028
Alternatives.Rationale: Wait for offset well results (Block 7324) for analogue data
